subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Anything that leads to death
solution:
The correct answer is "**Fatal**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **One word substitution is the use of one word in place of a wordy phrase **in order to make the sentence structure clearer.
 
• **The meaning**, with the replacement of the phrase** remains identical while the sentence becomes shorter.**
 
 
• **For example**: The one who does not believe in God : Atheist.
 
 
 
• In the same way, to substitute the group of words "Anything that leads to death", let us understand the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• **Scary means** something that can make us feel frightened.
 
 
• Example: The ghost in the movie was scary.
 
 
 
• **Serious means** something needing to be treated as important.
 
 
• Example: I want everyone to focus as this is a serious matter.
 
 
 
• **Fatal means **something causing or capable of causing death.
 
 
• Example: The illness she is suffering from is fatal.
 
 
 
• **Ominous means** suggesting that something bad is going to happen.
 
 
• Example: Those dark clouds are a bit ominous.
 
 
 
 
 
• From the above explained meanings, it can be inferred that **"fatal" is the required word**.
 
• Hence, the **correct answer is option 3) Fatal.**
